title: Traditional Spaghetti all’Amatriciana
description: There’s nothing like a spicy and tasty spaghetti all’Amatriciana dish to comfort you after a long day. This recipe is simple and really delicious.
ingredients: 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, divided, or more if needed
1 tablespoon water, or more as needed
1 pinch red pepper flakes, or to taste
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook onion until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Add pancetta and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Pour in passata, water, and sugar; cook until sauce has thickened, 10 to 15 minutes.
Drain spaghetti and toss with sauce, remaining olive oil, Parmesan cheese, and red pepper flakes. Season with salt and pepper.
